'''Weggland''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] under [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Naughlen]] and was defending Republic [[Outpost Shylon]] from an Imperial attack led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kligton]] when [[Empire's Wrath|the apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]] arrived on the scene. The apprentice was systematically dismantling the power base of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Rathari]] whom Kligton answered to and attacked his men when the General refused to switch sides. After Kligton and his soldiers were slain, Naughlen attempted to negotiate on behalf of himself and the garrison only to be slain by the Sith.
